title: Probabilistic modeling over permutations using quantum computers
summary: Quantum computers provide a super-exponential speedup for performing a Fourier transform over the symmetric group, an ability for which practical use cases have remained elusive so far. In this work, we leverage this ability to unlock spectral methods for machine learning over permutation-structured data, which appear in applications such as multi-object tracking and recommendation systems.
